DefaultEnvironment.name: The First (Default)
DefaultEnvironment.look: Classic rings and lasers over a dark runway. Fits almost anything.

TriangleEnvironment.name: Triangle
TriangleEnvironment.look: The classic rings and lasers inside a glowing triangular tunnel. Clean and all-purpose.

NiceEnvironment.name: Nice
NiceEnvironment.look: Rings with lasers above and below the track instead of at the sides. Bright and upbeat.

BigMirrorEnvironment.name: Big Mirror
BigMirrorEnvironment.look: A mirrored floor that reflects every light, like a ballroom. Warm and romantic.

KDAEnvironment.name: K/DA
KDAEnvironment.look: A glossy stage with glowing arrows and lasers. Sleek pop, rap and R&B.

DragonsEnvironment.name: Imagine Dragons
DragonsEnvironment.look: A rock stage with rings and side lights. Big, anthemic pop rock.

MonstercatEnvironment.name: Monstercat
MonstercatEnvironment.look: A dark stage under the Monstercat logo with lasers and spinning rings. Electronic and dance.

CrabRaveEnvironment.name: Crab Rave
CrabRaveEnvironment.look: The Monstercat stage in green and blue. Fun, bouncy electronic.

PanicEnvironment.name: Panic! at the Disco
PanicEnvironment.look: A dark theatrical hall with very bright rings. Dramatic, for songs that build.

RocketEnvironment.name: Rocket League
RocketEnvironment.look: A stadium arena in orange and blue. Fast, sporty and energetic.

OriginsEnvironment.name: Origins
OriginsEnvironment.look: Soft blue lights and spinning rings. Gentle, light and uplifting.

GreenDayEnvironment.name: Green Day
GreenDayEnvironment.look: A gritty rock stage with rings. Punk and rock.

GreenDayGrenadeEnvironment.name: Green Day Grenade
GreenDayGrenadeEnvironment.look: Green Day's stage with a giant grenade and haze instead of rings. Punk and rock.

TimbalandEnvironment.name: Timbaland
TimbalandEnvironment.look: A dark tunnel of ring lasers, with Timbaland's name always lit on the sides. Hip hop and R&B beats.

FitBeatEnvironment.name: FitBeat
FitBeatEnvironment.look: A neon tunnel of ring lasers and a chevron. Workout energy and steady pop beats.

LinkinParkEnvironment.name: Linkin Park
LinkinParkEnvironment.look: A cracked concrete hall with floor and ceiling lights. Heavy, intense rock.

BTSEnvironment.name: BTS
BTSEnvironment.look: A huge stage with a glowing logo, runway, spinning towers and rising pillars. Big K-pop.

KaleidoscopeEnvironment.name: Kaleidoscope
KaleidoscopeEnvironment.look: A spinning tunnel of spiked rings. Hazy, psychedelic, trippy.

InterscopeEnvironment.name: Interscope
InterscopeEnvironment.look: A street of hydraulic cars and lasers. Party, club and hip hop.

SkrillexEnvironment.name: Skrillex
SkrillexEnvironment.look: Two sets of rings and lasers in a wild neon space. Dubstep and heavy drops.

BillieEnvironment.name: Billie Eilish
BillieEnvironment.look: A sun or moon over water with rain and rays. Calm, moody, cinematic.

HalloweenEnvironment.name: Spooky
HalloweenEnvironment.look: A moonlit walkway with lasers. Halloween, eerie and playful.

GagaEnvironment.name: Lady Gaga
GagaEnvironment.look: Tall towers and auroras under the stars. Big, emotional and wide open.

WeaveEnvironment.name: Weave
WeaveEnvironment.look: Floating platforms crossed by spotlights. Minimal and precise. Built for the newer lighting system, so the lights made here only reach its platform lights.

PyroEnvironment.name: Fall Out Boy
PyroEnvironment.look: A concert stage with screens, spotlights and fire. Loud pop punk. Built for the newer lighting system, so the lights made here reach the stage but not its spotlights or fire.

EDMEnvironment.name: EDM
EDMEnvironment.look: A festival stage with rings and cone lasers. Electronic and dance. Built for the newer lighting system, so the lights made here only reach its lane and floor lights.
